texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]物种经历了只能被形容为“大觉醒”的蜕变，以往，我们伟大的灵能潜力便是我们物种固有的存在，虽然只在一小部分人身上有所展示，而如今……

几乎是一夜之间，身处各处的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都解锁了他们全部的灵能潜力，就像某种共通的[Root.GetSpeciesName]灵能能量池达到了激活值一样，将我们大脑中的灵能潜力集体激活。

心灵感应已经取代了[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]间大部分语音交流，而且这只是我们的社会面对的无数变化中的一小个而已。我们现在以一种我们过去难以想象的方式联系在了一起。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetSpeciesName] species has experienced what can only be described as a Great Awakening. For a time now, we have been aware of the great psionic potential inherent in our species, but such powers have only manifested themselves in a small minority... until now.

Almost overnight, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] everywhere have unlocked their full psionic capacity. It is as if some sort of communal pool of [Root.GetSpeciesName] psychic energy finally reached a critical tipping point, collectively awakening the latent abilities of our brains.

Telepathy has already replaced most verbal communication between [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and this is only one small example of the innumerable changes our society is faced with. We are now tied together in a way few of us could have ever imagined.

texts.zh:
星系各地的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都发生了一场深刻的转变。此前他们的潜在灵能只少量出现，现在他们群体总体都解放了全部的灵能潜质。

除了展现出一系列的强大灵能力以外，所有的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在还能在现有集体渠道之外交流。
texts.en:
All [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] throughout the galaxy have undergone a great change. Whereas before their latent psionic power had only emerged in a small minority, the entirety of their kind has now unlocked its full psionic potential.

Aside from displaying an array of powerful psionic abilities, all [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] can now communicate beyond their existing collective channels.

除了展现出一系列的强大灵能力以外，所有的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在还能在现有集体渠道之外交流。

Although these changes seem to have originated in the [From.GetName], they have now manifested in all members of their [GetSpeciesWord] regardless of location.

Aside from displaying an array of powerful psionic abilities, all [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] can now communicate beyond their existing collective channels.

尽管这些变化可能源自[From.GetName]，但他们的整个[GetSpeciesWord]无论身处何处都已经开始显现。
